title: French Algerian Eggplant Tagine
description: A flavorful French-inspired dish that combines the rich flavors of Algerian cuisine with tender eggplant.

ingredients.name: algerian spice blend
ingredients.notes: available at most Middle Eastern markets

instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of olive oil in a large skillet over high heat.
Add eggplant and sear until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Transfer eggplant to a large baking dish.
Heat remaining 1 tbsp of olive oil in the skillet over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add pea, tomato, and Algerian spice blend to the skillet.
Stir to combine and cook for 2 minutes.
Pour the mixture over the eggplant in the baking dish.
Cover the dish with foil and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 30 minutes.
Remove foil and continue baking for an additional 15-20 minutes, or until eggplant is tender.
